description: Parse a site's sitemap.xml (following one level of sitemap-index nesting) and check the HTTP status of every listed URL. Concurrency-limited, capped at 200 URLs checked per call. Reports broken/redirecting URLs found in the sitemap.

url.description: URL of the sitemap.xml to validate (or any page URL — /sitemap.xml on that origin is used)

name: sitemap_url_validator
